claims.evidence: Witness report photo 2 shows “EOS 5D” and “Mark II” text on the body, not Mark III.
No batteries are shown in the witness photos.
No charger is shown in the witness photos.
No Godox trigger is shown in the witness photos.
No shutter count screen or EXIF/shutter-count report is shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens is shown attached in the witness photos, so lens condition cannot be verified.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery/charger labels or inspection photos are shown.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (Mark II vs claimed Mark III) can change value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera top plate/model marking and/or the “About/Model” screen in-camera showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case identified body from the photos (EOS 5D Mark II) rather than the claimed Mark III.

risks.risk: Lens not included or not shown; without a lens the kit value drops significantly and functionality depends on what’s provided.
risks.proof: A photo showing the lens attached (front element, mount, and full lens) or separate photos of the exact lens model and condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (no lens).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (scratches/dents/cracks) on body, ports, buttons, and mount—may affect usability and resale.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: lens mount area, all ports (USB/HDMI), hot shoe, buttons/dials, and corners/edges under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic wear (used, not guaranteed pristine).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) and whether it has been cleaned—affects image quality.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall at f/16 plus a close-up of the sensor (or a sensor inspection photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/with possible sensor dust.

risks.risk: Functionality not tested (shutter, autofocus, buttons/dials, video, playback).
risks.proof: Short video clip showing recording + playback, and a still test showing autofocus lock on a subject.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume basic functions may need service.

risks.risk: Battery health and whether batteries/charger are genuine and working—affects runtime and reliability.
risks.proof: Photos of both batteries and charger labels + a clip showing the camera powering on and charging/reading battery.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming batteries/charger may be generic or weak (worst-case).

risks.risk: Accessories claim (Godox mini trigger) may be missing or incompatible.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact Godox mini trigger model and its ports/buttons, plus a quick test of triggering (optional).

proof_requests: Confirm exact model with a clear photo of the top/model marking (showing Mark II vs Mark III).
Show whether a lens is included: photo with lens attached and/or separate photos of the lens model and front element.
Provide close-ups of lens mount, ports, hot shoe, and all corners/edges for damage assessment.
Send a sensor test shot (blank wall at f/16) and/or a sensor inspection photo.
Show a short recording + playback clip and a still autofocus test.
Photo both batteries and the charger (labels visible) and show the camera powering on with battery level.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, while the seller claims Mark III; since the item type/model from the photos is sufficient to price at worst-case, we can proceed while treating unshown accessories and unverified condition claims as worst-case.
